$comment: Packages that Vite bundles into dist-renderer. They are devDependencies, so the packaged app does not install them, but their code ships. package-artifact.mjs, the advisory audit (scripts/dependency-advisory-exceptions.mjs) and the notices in vite.config.ts read this file. Each entry names the licence files of the package that go into dist-renderer/workspace-reader-notices.txt.
$bundledDependenciesComment: Dependencies of the packages above that the renderer bundle also contains: the Vue runtime build imports these.
